description: Tavuk Sis offers a delightful journey to the heart of Turkish cuisine, featuring succulent pieces of chicken marinated in a rich blend of spices and yogurt. These flavorful skewers are grilled to perfection, resulting in tender, juicy meat with a beautiful char. A true staple, perfect for any gathering or a delicious weeknight meal.

ingredients.notes: soak wooden skewers in water for 30 minutes

instructions.title: Prepare the Chicken
instructions.text: Pat the chicken breast cubes dry with paper towels. This helps the marinade adhere better and promotes a good sear when grilling. Set aside in a large bowl.

instructions.title: Make the Marinade
instructions.text: In a separate bowl, whisk together the yogurt, olive oil, tomato paste, minced garlic, grated onion, sweet paprika, ground cumin, dried oregano, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice until well combined. This creates the flavorful base for your Tavuk Sis.

instructions.title: Marinate the Chicken
instructions.text: Pour the prepared marinade over the chicken cubes in the large bowl. Toss gently to ensure all chicken pieces are thoroughly coated. Cover the bowl and refrigerate for at least 2 hours, or preferably overnight, for best flavor.

instructions.title: Prepare Skewers and Grill
instructions.text: If using wooden skewers, soak them in water for at least 30 minutes to prevent burning. Preheat your grill (charcoal, gas, or indoor grill pan) to medium-high heat. Lightly oil the grill grates.

instructions.title: Skewer the Chicken
instructions.text: Thread the marinated chicken pieces onto the prepared skewers. Do not pack them too tightly, leaving a small space between each piece for even cooking. You can optionally alternate with bell peppers, onions, or cherry tomatoes if desired.

instructions.title: Grill the Tavuk Sis
instructions.text: Place the chicken skewers on the preheated grill. Cook for 8-12 minutes, turning them every 2-3 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, lightly charred, and no longer pink inside. The internal temperature should reach 165°F (74°C).

instructions.title: Rest and Serve
instructions.text: Once cooked, remove the Tavuk Sis from the grill and let them rest for a few minutes before serving. This allows the juices to redistribute, ensuring tender and moist chicken. Serve hot with rice, pita bread, or a fresh salad.

tips: For the most tender chicken, ensure your yogurt is plain and full-fat. The acidity and fat in the yogurt help tenderize the chicken beautifully.
Do not overcrowd the skewers or the grill. Give the chicken space to cook evenly and get a nice char, rather than steaming.
Serve Tavuk Sis immediately after resting. It pairs wonderfully with Turkish rice pilaf, a simple shepherd's salad (Çoban SalatasÄ±), or warm lavash bread.
